text.en:
6th. MARCH, 2003 No. S 5 AUTHORITY FOR TNFO·COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY

INDUSTRY OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ORDER, 2001 (S 39/01) NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1), the Minister of Communications, with lhe approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. day of January, 2003 as the date on which the Authority for InfoCommunications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2001 shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 18th. day of Zulhijjah, 1423 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of February, 2003.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA AMAR PAHLAWAN

DATO SERI SETIA HAJI AWANG ZAKARIA BIN

DATU MAHAWANGSA HAJI SULAIMAN Minister of Communications, Brunei Darussalam.
